column1: # Bytes of the files a case's game writes that are not compared between the two games (tools/clickpass/files.py).
# offset: a number, or after:<text> (right after the first <text> in the file); length: a number, or eol (to the
# end of that line). Every row needs its reason; a row that hides a real difference is a false pass.

column4: the stored save path (game state 0x9A66C9, R13): each game's own folder; the dump compares the same path with the folder named instead (SavePath)

*MapTiles (0x94A30C) and *MapAbstract (0x94A310): the heap addresses of the tile and abstract map arrays, saved with the map block (0x949870, file offset 0x13A24) and replaced on load; two runs of the reference differ there too
the path of the last save (or load) in each game's own folder (R13); the dump compares the save path with the folder named instead (SavePath)
